modeling.acceptance: Measured silhouette/proportions and explicit owned targets; inspect actual views before detail.

materials.acceptance: Saved texture dependencies, correct channel colorspaces; shader metadata is not visual approval.

uv.acceptance: Explicit overlap policy, padding and measured density; inspect actual bake pixels when baking.

retopology.acceptance: Duplicate-only operations; preserve source, UVs and shape keys; deformation requires pose tests.

optimization.acceptance: Evaluated triangle/material budgets and inspected LOD transitions; no invented engine limits.

export.acceptance: Explicit target export and digest; target engine import and appearance remain separate gates.

validation.acceptance: Audit topology, geometry, UV, fit/collision, proportions, materials and scene preservation independently; absent measurements are NOT VERIFIED.
